import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,5); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
# ground
ax.plot([0,10],[1,1],'k-',lw=2); ax.text(0.2,0.6,'BP-1 bed')

# bin
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((7.8,0,1.5,1.5),fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(7.9,1.6,'bin')
ax.annotate('dump pivot rear', xy=(7.5,2.0), xytext=(5.0,4.2), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->'))
ax.set_title('Excavation and dump side view')
